purpose: Provenance and leakage audit for the immutable legacy synthetic benchmark split.

policy.paper_benchmark: Use these arrays unchanged with the released legacy checkpoints.
policy.future_training: Do not use this test split to train, select, or tune any new model. Create a newly Niggli-reduced and globally deduplicated split for future training instead.
policy.validation: Validation was drawn from the training partition and is not a protected paper holdout.

legacy_split_history.source_limitation: The historic parsed COD tables do not contain per-entry COD identifiers or an upstream archive checksum. They are retained solely as immutable derived paper assets, not as a rebuildable live COD snapshot.

gmm_sampler.array_identity_verified: The train_crystals and test_crystals stored in this sampler are byte-for-byte equal to every corresponding frozen split file.

gmm_fit_input_verified.evidence: src/unit_cell_generator.py: learn_crystal_distribution assigns self.train_crystals[lattice_type] to train_crystals, creates an internal validation subset from it, and calls GaussianMixture.fit(train_values). The code version at commit 19ed6c36d5c83cd702a9eda19d9d914ffe1e0bcd (2025-05-22), before the sampler timestamp, has the same train-only path. test_crystals is accessed only by get_testing_unit_cells.
gmm_fit_input_verified.qualification: This establishes that the sampler did not fit directly on test rows. It does not remove the Niggli-equivalent legacy rows reported below.

niggli_equivalent_cross_split_overlap.interpretation: The frozen legacy split is reproducible and the GMM fit was train-only, but it is not a perfectly Niggli-deduplicated held-out split. Keep it unchanged for exact reproduction of the existing checkpoints; do not describe it as leakage-free.
